title: Burnt To A Crisp
content: Hey everyone! It’s been awhile since my last post here— and that’s because after I posted my experience with the ‘Mall World,’ I didn’t dream about it again for a long time! It was nice to not be stuck in the same large ‘everything-building’ for a while, but the freedom didn’t last long. I just woke up a few hours ago from a dream where I was in the Mall World once again. In my dream, I remember doing something outside. I was outside the large building, and I was messing with some device that also had something to do with the sun. Like a mirror object that reflected the sun or something? I’m not quite sure or remember what the device was or its purpose— but it redirected sunlight. While messing with it, I accidentally redirected a beam of pure intense sunlight right on me. And it burnt me to a crisp. I was charred black and fried like a burnt hot dog. I couldn’t feel my eyelids or lips and I couldn’t breath though my nose. It was like I was in a zombified state afterwards— just reacting in pure shock. People around me started to freak out and that’s when I wondered inside the Mall World. Though I entered from a far side wing of the building and had to immediately go up many levels of stairs and trudge through different floors. It was like my body was on auto pilot, walking through the building as my mind raced with the reality that I was just burnt and this was my life now. It all felt so… vivid. While I was walking up the stairs of each floor, a group of paramedics were chasing after me. This is a fun twist on a theme that happens a lot in these dreams of min. If you remember my last post, I commented about how men in black chase me through buildings and such. However this time, they were chasing after me with a stretcher to HELP me. They cornered me in an elevator I found, and as soon as I saw them I laid down on the stretcher and I begged them to help me. I kept going on about how my face was ruined and how everything was burnt and I would scar forever and how I wish this never happened, all while they carried me down each floor and to the hospital section of the world. When they dropped me off at the hospital, there were other patients in the waiting room or I guess ‘emergency room bed section’. They were all looking at me because I was legit BURNT to a crisp but before the paramedics left one of them was very sweet and he told me that I had nice lips and there was no way that my face was ruined and I was too cute to worry or something like that and it was a really sweet thing to say to someone who was so concerned about being beautiful. When I woke up from the dream, I was very happy I was no longer burnt but now I’m just left with this uncomfortable feeling. Shout Out to the paramedics tho! 🙌🏽
